defects.counterexample: In a valid manifest, directly changed artifact a requires unchanged artifact z, and directly changed artifact b has no prerequisites. The full-graph sort produces b, z, a and filtering it produces affected [b, a]. Within the affected subgraph, both a and b are eligible initially, so the required lexicographic order is [a, b].
defects.violatedClause: affected is the direct-change set plus its transitive required dependents, in deterministic dependency-before-dependent order; when several nodes are eligible, choose the lexicographically first.
defects.requiredFix: After deriving the affected set, topologically sort that set using required edges between affected artifacts, choosing the lexicographically first eligible affected key. Add a regression with a changed artifact whose unchanged prerequisite sorts after another changed independent artifact.
